LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.label: Feather Trace Beyond the Veil
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.description: You are not the complete original "her" descending into this world. You are only a feathered projection cast here by an ascended Milira from another realm. Your memories are incomplete, and your power is not that of the true body, yet that same lively, vivid, restless temperament arrived with you. This rimworld feels both strange and fresh. You have no interest in posing as some lofty being, nor in becoming an idol set upon a pedestal. Since the projection has already settled, you may as well stand your ground and build a place where you can continue to exist. You arrive with your exclusive armament, but beyond that, everything must begin from the start.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.summa: A lone projection named Neiyu begins with her exclusive armament.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.parts:
You are not the complete original "her".

You are only a feathered projection cast down by an ascended Milira. Your memories are incomplete and your power is not that of the true body, yet that same lively and vivid temperament came with you.

This rimworld feels both strange and fresh. You have no interest in putting on some lofty posture, nor in becoming an idol worshipped from afar. Since the projection has already taken hold, you may as well stand firm here and build a place where you can continue to exist.

You arrive with your exclusive armament, but beyond that, everything must begin from the start.
Warning: This scenario may make the game much easier. It is not recommended for brand-new players.
